'''Antar''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Prindaar system/Legends|Prindaar system]], surrounded by six [[Moon/Legends|moons]], four of which supported life.

==History==
Discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] Antar was considered from this time under the control of the Republic along with its [[Moon/Legends|moons]], [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]] and [[Antar 5|5]].<ref name="TEA" />

Antar 4 was inhabited by the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] race. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], one of Antar's [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|uninhabited moons]] was damaged as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]], the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], attempted to jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], but drove directly into the moon.<ref name="DM" />

The Gotal homeworld of Antar 4 had a highly unusual orbit around its gas giant star, which caused extreme variations in the amount of light striking the planet on any given day. The Gotals were well adapted to their unique conditions. There was generally no organized central government. Given the planet's Separatist past, the Imperials closely watched the system for any signs of Rebel activity or sympathetic actions, a task made more difficult by the decentralized nature of Gotal society.<ref name="Age of Rebllion">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
